# Expected Changes for Patch 46 (Season 14) [08/22/2023]

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_202_nukaknights-post-patch46-expected-changes.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update August 15th, 2023]** Season 13 ends and update on August 22nd. have now been confirmed **[Update August 9th, 2023]** New player setups have been postponed to a later patch and are now at the bottom of the post; Added Season 14 rewards list

The next season and patch 46 are already around the corner. We have already observed many changes on the PTS, some of which were released in the last patch. However, many changes are still open and are now expected in Patch 46. The date for the update has not yet been finally confirmed, but the end date was set on August 22nd, 2023 on Steam at the beginning of Season 13. The official community calendar also says August. Since these are both official information, I would say on August 22nd. or August 29, 2023 expect the update for Patch 46. If other dates become known here, the article will be updated.

## Patch notes changes

- There are now level 10 versions of the T-45 and Raider Power armor
- There is a new filter for new perk cards
- Below level 50, players will now receive a warning when attempting to join a daily operation.
- All workbench lists use alphabetical sorting.
- Item names in the workbench are standardized across all lists.
- The "Show Unlockables" button now displays recipes that you can learn through a plan, through scrapping, or purchase from the Atomic Shop.
- Unlearned recipes will display the name of the plan you need, the item you need to scrap, or allow purchase from the Atom Shop.
- 1-star Legendary Mods will no longer appear under “Random Legendary Mods”. 2 and 3 star mods are now correctly displayed under “Current Mods” when examining an item.
- The learned mod counter has been improved.

## Patch notes design changes

- We have lowered the level requirements for various perk cards.
- Added more standard CAMP recipes for all players.
- The fight in Morgantown and Summerville has been rebalanced.
- The Liberator Bots outside of Vault 76 have been replaced by Ghouls.
- The frequency of enemy attacks on the player's CAMP has been reduced
- Adjusted the Gun Fu perk effect and text description.
- The bugs have been eradicated and the mysterious construction of the Gilman Lumber Mill has begun.
- Renamed over 600 CAMP items.
- The Hunter/Hunted radio station and event have been removed.
- The description of “A Poem with Salt” accurately reflects the impact of the change. The Refrigerated mod cannot be combined with the perk.
- The Grenadier perk now applies to Gauss weapons.
- Players will no longer receive legendary power armor pieces as rewards for events and quests up to level 20.
- Legendary creatures no longer mutate at 50% health to gain health regeneration, but instead have increased health by 60%.
- Various changes to health, resistances and weapon damage for the following creatures: Super Mutant, Protectron, Mole Rat, Mr.Handy/Gutsy, Feral Ghoul, Scorched, Glowing One, Assaultron, Mirelurk King, Mirelurk Crab, Cave Cricket, Radscorpion, Angler, Floater Flamer, Floater Freeza, Floater Gnasher, Mutant Hound, Liberator and Mirelurk Hunter.
- Reduced the amount of pop-up information when exiting the vault.
- Increase the number of utility items in low-level quest rewards and challenges.
- Daily Ops Rewards will give players priority rewards for unlearned recipes. Once all recipes are learned, players will receive replays.
- Other players can use your CAMP's bone bells
